text: おとこのこが　４にん　せんろのうえを　あるいてる…　…　ぼくも　もう　いかなきゃ！
note: This describes the 1986 American film Stand by Me, in which four boys walk along railroad tracks on a journey. The player is about to leave home in the same way.
